note: Blueprints are research requirements, not evidence of collection, model use or predictive value.

fb_side.outcome: Team wins outright / covers a fixed margin over full game (OT rule per rules text)
fb_side.distribution: score-difference residual around market-implied mean; empirical mass at 3,7 (NFL) and 3,7,10 (CFB); OT tie-break branch
fb_side.settle: does OT count; spread push handling; postponed/suspended game void rule
fb_side.pit: injury/QB status and weather forecast must be the vintage visible before the quote; never final box score, final inactives or realized weather
fb_side.history: 5+ seasons of closing spread/ML with final margin for residual and key-number mass; per-team strength history by week

fb_total.outcome: Combined points over/under a strike (full game, incl. OT per rules)
fb_total.distribution: sum of two correlated scoring processes (drives x points/drive; TD 6-8, FG 3, safety 2); negative-binomial or lattice; key-number mass on totals
fb_total.key_numbers: total strikes at half-points; mass at common sums (41,44,47,51 NFL); OT adds ~
fb_total.pit: injury/QB status and weather forecast must be the vintage visible before the quote; never final box score, final inactives or realized weather
fb_total.history: drive-level history (drives/game, points/drive), pace, weather-total interaction, closing total vs result

fb_team_total.outcome: One team's points over/under a strike
fb_team_total.distribution: team-points marginal derived from (game total, spread) -> team means; overdispersed count with TD/FG lattice
fb_team_total.key_numbers: team strikes cluster near 17,20,24,27,30 (mass at multiples of 3 and 7)
fb_team_total.settle: OT counts?; which team = named side
fb_team_total.pit: injury/QB status and weather forecast must be the vintage visible before the quote; never final box score, final inactives or realized weather
fb_team_total.history: team-points history by opponent strength, implied team totals vs actual

fb_half_side.outcome: Winner / margin of 1st or 2nd half (ties possible)
fb_half_side.distribution: half-margin distribution; 2H depends on 1H state (script); P(tie) non-trivial
fb_half_side.settle: tie handling for half winner; does half include OT
fb_half_side.pit: injury/QB status and weather forecast must be the vintage visible before the quote; never final box score, final inactives or realized weather
fb_half_side.history: half-level scoring history; 1H->2H adjustment history (coach conservatism, garbage time)

fb_half_total.outcome: Combined points in 1st or 2nd half over/under strike
fb_half_total.distribution: half-points count distribution; 1H scripted vs 2H state-dependent; 2H affected by OT=excluded?
fb_half_total.pit: injury/QB status and weather forecast must be the vintage visible before the quote; never final box score, final inactives or realized weather
fb_half_total.history: half scoring history by team/opponent, opening-script history, 2H-vs-1H pace ratio

fb_quarter_total.outcome: Combined points in one quarter (Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4) over/under strike
fb_quarter_total.distribution: very low-count lattice: P(0), P(3), P(6/7), P(10), P(13/14)...; zero-inflated; Q1 depends on opening possession and opening script
fb_quarter_total.key_numbers: Q1 strikes 3.5-10.5; mass at 0,3,7,10; scoreless quarter probability material
fb_quarter_total.settle: quarter boundary vs OT; score-at-end-of-quarter definition; push handling
fb_quarter_total.pit: injury/QB status and weather forecast must be the vintage visible before the quote; never final box score, final inactives or realized weather
fb_quarter_total.history: quarter-level scoring history (P0/P3/P7 by team and opponent), opening-drive outcomes, coin-toss/deferral rates, kicker range/FG attempt rates

fb_quarter_side.distribution: quarter-margin lattice with large tie mass (scoreless or equal scores)
fb_quarter_side.settle: tie = push or void or third outcome?; quarter-end definition
fb_quarter_side.pit: injury/QB status and weather forecast must be the vintage visible before the quote; never final box score, final inactives or realized weather
fb_quarter_side.history: quarter-level score differences by team; tie frequencies by quarter

fb_overtime.distribution: P(tie after regulation) from final-margin distribution mass at 0 (~6% NFL; CFB similar)
fb_overtime.pit: injury/QB status and weather forecast must be the vintage visible before the quote; never final box score, final inactives or realized weather
fb_overtime.history: history of regulation ties vs closing total/spread

fb_margin_bucket.outcome: Winning margin falls in a bucket (e.g. 1-6, 7-12...)

fb_margin_bucket.pit: injury/QB status and weather forecast must be the vintage visible before the quote; never final box score, final inactives or realized weather
